description_en: Queries the list of HTTP response header modification configurations for a site
description_zh: 查询站点的修改HTTP响应头的配置列表
name: ListHttpResponseHeaderModificationRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. You can use this parameter to query global or rule configurations. Valid values:
global: queries global configurations.
rule: queries rule configurations.

This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, both global and rule configurations are returned
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，可以根据此参数查全局配置或者规则配置，取值范围：
global：查询全局配置。
rule：查询规则配置。

该参数可以不传，不传时不区分全局或者规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

Configs.description_en: The list of HTTP response header modifications

items.description_en: The details of an HTTP response header modification

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
global: global configuration.
rule: rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置

ResponseHeaderModification.description_en: The response header modifications. Three operations are supported: add, delete, and modify
ResponseHeaderModification.description_zh: 修改响应头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式

items.description_en: The details of a response header

Operation.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
add: adds a response header.
del: deletes a response header.
modify: modifies a response header
Operation.description_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：
add：添加。
del：删除
modify：变更

Type.description_en:
The value type. Valid values:
static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic schema
Type.description_zh:
值类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specific requests: set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when you add a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
